name: Zul'Gurub: a commanded Ghoul's area attack reaches the chosen Shade of Jin'do (#11573)
contract: Issue #11573: a Necromancer's minions deal no damage to the Shades of Jin'do (14986). The shade's
creature_immunities -95 carries ImmuneAoE, so WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck drops it from every area and
cone search, and the Ghoul's Command: Ghouls (801514, TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, 10 yd) never selected it.
Command: Undead (504868) reads 'Command your Undead minions to perform a unique attack on your target', so the
commanded target is the one exception: spell_ascension_necromancer_command_area adds the Necromancer's
Command focus to its minions' area and cone command attacks when that focus avoids area damage and stands
inside the effect's radius, arc and line of sight. A second shade beside it stays AoE-immune. Two Ghouls each
cast once, so a single Command: Ghouls miss cannot fail the hit assertion on its own.

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura settle
CONTROL: the Necromancer is in Zul'Gurub
Curse the Necromancer with the Delusions vision
A second shade inside the same Ghoul radius
Let the shades take their invisibility
CONTROL: the shade carries its invisibility
CONTROL: the cursed Necromancer sees the shade
CONTROL: no Ghoul has hit the shade before the order
Command: Ghouls damages the commanded shade
Allow every Ghoul's cast to land
DISCRIMINATING: the shade that was not commanded keeps its area immunity
